Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Represents a user's tiffin subscription order.

fullName.description: The full name of the subscriber.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number of the subscriber.

planName.description: The name of the tiffin plan chosen.

period.description: The billing period of the plan.

paymentMethod.description: The payment method chosen by the subscriber.

status.description: The current status of the subscription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription was submitted.

userId.description: The UID of the user who created the subscription (if authenticated).

/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.description: A collection of all subscription orders placed by users.
